authority: explicit current user instruction to make the extracted Weighted/Log BRC tools and theorems part of the foundation for all research
purpose: Expose only the minimal typed branch commitments universally; detailed theorem IDs, examples, successful routes and tool catalogs remain lazy and must not choose a free research question.
commitments: BRANCHING_IS_TYPED: Boolean support, positive weighted multiplicity/mass, provenance, and signed/amplitude data are distinct carriers unless an explicit reduction theorem identifies them.

DECLARED_MULTIPLICITY_IS_NOT_DEFAULT_DISCARDABLE: when a problem itself declares multiple branch representatives and their multiplicity or positive weights matter, do not silently collapse them to Boolean support before testing what is lost.

POSITIVE_WEIGHTED_BRANCH_MINIMAL_CARRIER: for finite positive-rational branch families the shared exact summary available to research is CWM=(C,W,M), carrying supported path count, total positive mass, and dominant path mass.

LOG_IS_DERIVED: E=W/M and Delta=LN(E) are derived readout coordinates for live positive CWM states; LN/LOG are not primitive native state and need not be materialized during exact branch accumulation.

FINITE_RATIONAL_RECURRENCE_CERTIFIED: for any finite non-negative rational transition-mass matrix W, total all-depth positive mass is stable iff there exists a positive rational potential h with Wh<h; after denominator clearing this has an exact positive integer certificate, and the complementary divergent phase has an exact nonzero non-negative integer left certificate.

RECURRENT_GAUGE_LOCALIZATION: finite rational mass stability is equivalent to a positive rational state gauge in which every outgoing total-mass row sum is strictly below one; closed-cycle products are gauge-invariant.

RECURRENT_LOOP_ARITHMETIC: stable finite positive-rational recurrence has exact gauge-invariant determinant/loop-zeta, edge-response, response-Hessian and integer criticality-polynomial interfaces; these are derived recurrent observables rather than primitive spectral state.

RATIONAL_GAUGE_ARITHMETIC: positive rational vertex-gauge data may be retained exactly as finite-support prime-valuation integer cohomology before logarithmic readout; spanning-tree gauge and power-class decompositions are available when the problem declares such rational gauge structure.

SHADOW_INCOMPLETENESS: mod-m and C2/parity holonomy shadows are typed forgetful projections and must never be assumed to determine the full positive rational gauge state, recurrent phase, or loop surplus without a separate theorem.
DETERMINANT_SIGN_BOUNDARY: alternating signs in finite determinant/cycle-system certificates are inclusion-exclusion coefficients and are not signed/amplitude Weighted-BRC branch states.
SIGNED_BOUNDARY: positive Weighted-BRC does not encode signed/amplitude cancellation or reflection-odd orientation after positive recoalescence.

DETERMINISTIC_DEGENERATION: a single deterministic positive path has C=1, W=M, E=1 and Delta=0; the weighted layer contributes no extra multiplicity information and should not be forced onto deterministic problems.
BOOLEAN_BASE_PRESERVED: canonical R023 Boolean result-support BRC remains the base support semantics and is not mutated by the weighted layer.

RECURRENT_SCOPE_BOUNDARY: finite non-negative rational transition-mass systems are covered; do not extrapolate this certificate theorem to infinite state spaces, signed/amplitude recurrence, complex weights, or arbitrary non-rational exact weights without a separate theorem. Perron-Frobenius/spectral-radius language remains a classical external equivalent rather than a required primitive certificate.

phase_a_anti_anchoring.rule: These commitments are background typing rules, not a research agenda. FREE Phase A must still generate its own question from the primitive substrate and may open detailed Weighted-BRC theorem/tool surfaces only after the self-generated problem actually contains the relevant typed branch structure.
forbidden: presenting weighted-BRC theorem IDs as suggested research questions
preloading successful arithmetic/selector/holonomy/recurrent-matrix/loop-zeta examples to steer question choice
forcing a multiplicity, rational-gauge, determinant, or loop interpretation onto deterministic, signed, or unrelated problems
